question: The value of the e×pression (1 - sin(2t))/(1 + sin(2t)) times (cos(t) + sin(t))/(cos(t) - sin(t)) is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put t = 30° to quickly evaluate the expression and eliminate options.

Expression = [(1 − sin(60°)) / (1 + sin(60°))] × [(cos(30°) + sin(30°)) / (cos(30°) − sin(30°))]

Expression = [(1 − √3/2) / (1 + √3/2)] × [(√3/2 + 1/2) / (√3/2 − 1/2)]

Expression = (7 − 4√3) × (2 + √3) = 2 − √3.

Checking given options for t = 30°, Option 2 gives: (1 − tan(30°)) / (1 + tan(30°)) = (1 − 1/√3) / (1 + 1/√3) = (√3 − 1) / (√3 + 1) = 2 − √3.

**∴ The correct answer is (1 − tan(t)) / (1 + tan(t)).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = [(1 − sin(2t)) / (1 + sin(2t))] × [(cos(t) + sin(t)) / (cos(t) − sin(t))]

**Formula Used:**

1 = sin²(t) + cos²(t)

sin(2t) = 2sin(t)cos(t)

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1 − sin(2t) = cos²(t) + sin²(t) − 2sin(t)cos(t) = (cos(t) − sin(t))²

⇒ 1 + sin(2t) = cos²(t) + sin²(t) + 2sin(t)cos(t) = (cos(t) + sin(t))²

Substitute these values into the given expression:

⇒ Expression = [(cos(t) − sin(t))² / (cos(t) + sin(t))²] × [(cos(t) + sin(t)) / (cos(t) − sin(t))]

Cancel out the common terms from numerator and denominator:

⇒ Expression = (cos(t) − sin(t)) / (cos(t) + sin(t))

Divide numerator and denominator by cos(t):

⇒ Expression = [1 − (sin(t) / cos(t))] / [1 + (sin(t) / cos(t))]

⇒ Expression = (1 − tan(t)) / (1 + tan(t))

**∴ The correct answer is (1 − tan(t)) / (1 + tan(t)).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Double Angle Formulas

sin(2θ) = 2sin(θ)cos(θ) and cos(2θ) = cos²(θ) − sin²(θ).

Tangent Addition Formula

tan(A − B) = (tan(A) − tan(B)) / (1 + tan(A)tan(B)). Applying this for A = 45° gives tan(45° − θ) = (1 − tan(θ)) / (1 + tan(θ)).

Pythagorean Identities

sin²(θ) + cos²(θ) = 1, which is commonly used to convert 1 ± sin(2θ) into perfect square expressions like (cos(θ) ± sin(θ))².
</p
